<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
  
  <text x="200" y="30" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111">
    Pressure Formula
  </text>
  
  
  <rect x="50" y="60" width="300" height="80" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" rx="4" />
  
  
  <text x="200" y="95" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111" font-family="serif">
    P = F / A
  </text>
  
  
  <text x="200" y="130" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111">
    Pressure = Force ÷ Area
  </text>
  
  
  <g>
    <text x="80" y="180" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#111">Force (F)</text>
    <text x="80" y="200" font-size="11" fill="#111">Unit: Newton (N)</text>
    
    
    <line x1="80" y1="220" x2="80" y2="250" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2" />
    <polygon points="80,250 75,240 85,240" fill="#111" />
    <circle cx="80" cy="215" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
  </g>
  
  
  <g>
    <text x="320" y="180" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#111">Area (A)</text>
    <text x="320" y="200" font-size="11" fill="#111">Unit: m²</text>
    
    
    <rect x="300" y="220" width="40" height="40" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <text x="320" y="250" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111">A</text>
  </g>
  
  
  <rect x="50" y="270" width="300" height="20" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="200" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111">
    Pressure Unit: Pascal (Pa) = N/m²
  </text>
</svg>
